purpose: Phase-7C endogenous checkpoint-pressure structure: PD-1, PD-L1, CTLA-4. Models ENDOGENOUS checkpoint-related pressure ONLY - checkpoint-inhibitor treatment / blockade is NOT modelled here (it belongs to a later treatment/combination layer). PD-1 and PD-L1 are kept as separate components and only then combined into a derived PD-1/PD-L1 axis pressure (never merged into one unexplained constant). Section 1 establishes the contract; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1]; no receptor/ligand expression level (NOT_REPORTED).

derived_axes.pd1_pdl1_axis_pressure: combined from the separate PD-1 and PD-L1 component records (interaction potential), bounded [0,1]
derived_axes.ctla4_pressure: from the CTLA-4 component record, bounded [0,1]

coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: if checkpoint inputs are unavailable, the axis is UNAVAILABLE (never set to zero) and downstream suppression/escape confidence is reduced.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No PD-1/PD-L1/CTLA-4 expression level; no checkpoint-inhibitor treatment response (excluded).
